# The packages the three jobs in repo.yml install. No requirements file lived
# in-tree before 2026-08-29; this one exists so `setup-python`'s pip cache has
# a dependency path to key on, and it is deliberately the ONLY reason it
# exists -- it is not a project manifest and nothing outside CI reads it.
#
# Pinned loosely on purpose, carrying forward the workflow's own note: a
# resolver surprise here should look like a resolver surprise, not like a repo
# failure. Tighten a line only when a real break makes the pin the fix.
#
# One shared file for all three jobs, so all three share one cache key. The
# `lints` job does not import pytest and `patch-sentinel` needs no pillow or
# numpy; installing a little extra costs seconds on a cold cache and nothing
# on a warm one, and it buys a single cache that every job restores.
pytest
# Added 2026-08-29 ([USER]). CI now runs the same `-n auto --dist loadscope`
# arm the local push gate runs; see repo.yml's `pytest` job.
pytest-xdist
pyyaml
pillow
numpy
